root.description: The workspace root. The shell injects it; the renderer cannot choose it.

path.description: The collection folder, relative to the root.

format.description: The document to produce. Postman collection v2.1 is the only one today.

export.collection.result.description: The exported document. Nothing is written: the shell saves it where the user chooses.

name.description: The collection's name, suggested as the file name.

content.description: The document. Values are exactly what the YAML holds: a {{name}} reference is never resolved, so no secret value is ever in it.

warnings.description: Everything the format could not carry: environments, assertions, captures, file contents, settings with no Postman field. Omitted when empty.
